title: Can I MASTER Giveaway Chess?
summary: The creator plays chess.com Giveaway (antichess) against online humans, calling it his worst variant (rated just under 1500). Players try to lose all their pieces and capturing is compulsory. Goal: win five games; he plays seven games, losing to a ~2000-rated opponent in game 2 (he notes stalemate also counted as a win for that opponent) and finishing 5 wins at game 7.
rules: Capturing is compulsory: if any capture is available you must capture (you may choose which).
The king has no royal power: no check, no checkmate, king can be captured; castling not allowed (chess.com antichess rule, inferred).
Pawns may promote to a king as well as Q/R/B/N (chess.com giveaway rule, inferred).
A player with no legal moves (stalemated) WINS (transcript 4:54 'I believe stalemate is also a win for my opponent').
win_condition: Lose all your pieces (or be stalemated) to win. Series goal: 5 wins.

opponent.name: Online humans (e.g. La-Douine)
opponent.avatar_description: Generic chess.com human avatar; remake: grey silhouette with random username, ~1500-2000.

events: Forced-capture: only capturing moves are legal when any capture exists (moves highlighted).
Result card '(king) WINS' shown when someone runs out of pieces.
visual_fx: Purple 'WINS' result card with king icon (reference sprite rBh7IIhTbw4_king_wins_card.png).
current_impl_issues: Legacy base:Giveaway matches the core rule; verify stalemate counts as a win for the stalemated side and that promotion to king is offered.
